summary: Build a free client-facing website for PIXEL NOVA DIGITALS that provides AI-based services (text-to-video, text-to-image, text-to-voiceover, and other AI tools) for customers.
architectural_notes: Platform is intended to be 100% free for clients.
Primary value proposition is AI self-service tools for clients (text-to-video, text-to-image, text-to-voiceover, etc.).
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- PIXEL NOVA DIGITALS logo, clean modern mark with digital/creative feel (pnd-logo.dim_512x512.png)
- Website hero illustration with abstract digital creative tools motif, modern and minimal (pnd-hero.dim_1600x900.png)
- Set of three simple monochrome icons: image, video, microphone/voice (pnd-tool-icons.dim_256x256.png)

existing_features.title: Create a client-facing website for “PIXEL NOVA DIGITALS” that is 100% free to use and clearly presents the available AI-based tools: Text-to-Image, Text-to-Video, Text-to-Voiceover, and a placeholder area for additional future tools.

Add a Text-to-Image tool page that accepts a text prompt and produces a generated image result entirely on the client (no external AI/LLM service dependency), with options to download the output image.

Add a Text-to-Voiceover tool page that accepts text input and produces voiceover audio using a client-side approach (e.g., browser speech synthesis), with basic controls (play/pause/stop) and an option to download/export audio when feasible in-browser.

Add a Text-to-Video tool page that accepts a text prompt and produces a simple generated video result entirely on the client (e.g., animated text/scene rendered in-browser and recorded), with a preview and a download option.
Add basic user accounts using Internet Identity so clients can sign in and see their own generation history (prompts and resulting downloadable assets metadata) across sessions.
Provide a cohesive, distinct visual theme for the site (colors, typography, spacing, component styling) and apply it consistently across the landing page and all tool pages. Avoid default-looking UI.
Add generated static brand assets (logo + hero illustration + tool icons) to the frontend and use them in the UI from the static assets folder (do not fetch images from the backend).

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a 100% free client-facing website for PIXEL NOVA DIGITALS offering AI-based digital services
Add Text-to-Video generation tool for clients
Add Text-to-Image generation tool for clients
Add Text-to-Voiceover (text-to-speech) generation tool for clients
Support additional AI-based services/tools beyond text-to-video/image/voiceover
Implement backend persistence in the single Motoko actor to store per-user generation records (type, prompt/text, createdAt, and references/identifiers needed by the frontend).
